keyTakeaways: Ganga river enters UP at Bijnor district and exits UP at Ballia district
Yamuna river enters UP at Saharanpur and merges with Ganga at Prayagraj (Sangam)

Betwa, Ken, Chambal are major right-bank tributaries of Yamuna in Bundelkhand region
